title: Trim curve +
tagline: Trim or split wires at exact arc-length positions: at points, signed distances from a point, even divisions, or inflections.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: Native Trim curve trims up to one entity. Trim curve + reads each wire -- multi-edge too -- as one path and cuts it where you say, exactly, splitting into pieces or trimming away one side.
useWhen: Cut a set distance from a point
Divide evenly, or split at inflections
slides.caption: T1 at points, T9 by distances.

slides.title: The dialog
params: At points / Up to entity / Distance from point / Even division / At inflections.
(At points) off-curve picks are projected (dashed preview).
(Split) one wire split in place; off = separate wires, source deleted.
(Trim) keep the other piece (default: end side).

slides.title: Cut locations
params: Where the curve meets it (nearest point per edge).
From point + signed Distance (Opposite direction); Split: Additional distances, Also split at reference point.
Between two points (segments; also cuts at both) / Every distance from point (spacing, count).
Click the red dots, or the one nearest each end (one planar, single-edge curve).

slides.title: Examples: T1 and T9
slides.head: T1: at 2 points (one 6 mm off) -> 100 / 357.08 / 100. T9: 50, extra 150 and -80 -> 20 / 130 / 100 / 307.08
slides.body: Also tested: split in place (T2, 5 edges), trim (T3), a mate connector point (T7), and 600 mm past the end -> error (T8).

keys: The vertices at the cuts (2 per cut when split into separate wires).
The pieces (bodies, or edges when split in place).

items.head: Separate pieces
items.body: The source wire is deleted: downstream references to it break. Use Return single wire to keep it.

items.head: Directions
items.body: Distance: positive = path direction. Spacing: away from the midpoint by default.
